$comment: Build log. Add an entry only when the thing has actually happened. Never edit dates. Times are UTC. proof.label names the receipt (commit hash, post, tx); proof.href is added once it is publicly reachable.

entries.title: Project started
entries.detail: Empty folder. Idea: a meme coin about a receipt that only prints what it can prove.

entries.title: Name picked: CHEK ($CHEK)
entries.detail: First draft was RECEIPTS / $RCPT. A name check found the ticker already in use, so we renamed before publishing anything. Чек = receipt. The check = the bill. Check = what you should do.

entries.title: Mascot drawn
entries.detail: Chek exists: 7 expressions, 6 poses, drawn as code so every image comes from one source.

entries.title: Website v0 deployed
entries.detail: chekcoin.vercel.app claimed. Static site, contract shown as NOT LAUNCHED YET.

entries.title: Brand system + villains
entries.detail: Logo mark, avatars, X header, token image, OG card, meme kit. Two villains join the lore: The Shredder and The Coupon.

entries.title: Website v1
entries.detail: Transparency page, meme kit, 404. Every section of the receipt is live.

entries.title: Pump.fun facts checked
entries.detail: Fees, limits and token settings re-checked against Pump.fun docs and fresh mainnet mints. Creator fee (0.30% of curve trades) disclosed in Tokenomics.

entries.title: Content bank ready
entries.detail: 26 X posts, 11 Telegram posts, 10 memes, 5 mascot images, a reaction GIF. Nothing posted yet — posts go out on schedule, starting when the accounts open.

entries.title: Launch-minute rehearsal
entries.detail: Full dry run of publishing a contract address on a real pump.fun coin in a throwaway copy (nothing published). It caught a bug in our tooling; fixed.

entries.title: Pre-launch checklist
entries.detail: 27 automatic checks pass. Waiting on: X and Telegram accounts, launch date.
